_sample_note: Sample 04 (reference suite): encrypted CSV export egress, fully self-contained in the {{catalog}}.metaflow_sample schema. Two APPEND ingestion flows land order/customer slices, and TWO transformation flows join them (stream-static inner joins -- the driving side streams the append-only raw table, the dimension side is a batch read of the sibling table) into TWO genuine Lakeflow sinks (target_type 'sink': dlt.create_sink + @dlt.append_flow, never a persisted table). Each sink stages rows as CSV (sink_config.staged_file_format, NEW in v1.6.0) and post_export_archive packs every micro-batch into an AES-256 password-protected ZIP under /Volumes/{{catalog}}/metaflow_sample/exports/ -- protected via post_export_archive.secret (the ZIP's own password, resolved from the UC secret {{catalog}}.metaflow_sample.sample_zip_passkey), deliberately INSTEAD of pgp_encryption (Sample 04 shows the passkey-ZIP shape; metaflow_testing/041_snk_003_pgp_zip_sink.json shows the PGP shape). MANUAL PREREQUISITE: that UC secret must exist before the pipeline runs -- see the job resource header (resources/sample_jobs/metaflow_sample_04_export_encrypt_zip_job.yml) and the seed notebook's fail-fast preflight.

ingestion_flows.source_description: Sample 04: order feed (samples.tpch.orders slices, a distinct key range per iteration), Auto Loader-ingested into an APPEND streaming table -- the streaming driving side of both export joins.
Sample 04: customer dimension feed (samples.tpch.customer slices), Auto Loader-ingested into an APPEND streaming table -- the static dimension side of both export joins.

transformation_flows.source_description: Sample 04 export #1: every order enriched with its customer (stream-static inner join), staged as CSV and packed per micro-batch into an AES-256 password-protected ZIP under exports/customer_orders/output/.
transformation_flows.transformation_sql: SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.market_segment, o.order_status, o.total_price, o.order_date FROM exp04_orders_stream o INNER JOIN exp04_customers_dim c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id

transformation_flows.source_description: Sample 04 export #2: the high-value slice (total_price >= 150000) of the same stream-static join, staged as CSV and packed per micro-batch into its own AES-256 password-protected ZIP under exports/high_value_orders/output/ -- a second, independent dlt.create_sink over the same two source tables (the read-once source plane serves both exports from one scan per update).
transformation_flows.transformation_sql: SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id, c.customer_name, o.total_price, o.order_date FROM exp04_hv_orders_stream o INNER JOIN exp04_hv_customers_dim c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.total_price >= 150000
